zh: 词库页顶部钉住了：词库标签条和搜索/筛选栏固定在上方，词表在下面滚动，翻得再远也知道自己在哪个词库、筛了什么。新建词库重做——表单直接出现在列表下方，名称为空会就地提示「请输入词库名称」而不是点了没反应（安卓上「点创建没反应」就是这个原因），键盘弹出时自动滚到「创建」按钮，手机端语言选择纵向排列、按钮拉满宽度。练习页的复习/测验分栏改为按正文宽度计算、卡面至少 560dp，宽屏窗口不会再把卡片挤成窄条。闪卡按参考图重塑：卡片后两层纸缘错位露出，正面只留词性标签和单词，卡下新增收藏/朗读/跳过圆形动作排。
en: The top of the word library is now pinned: the list tabs and the search and filter bar stay put while the words scroll underneath, so you always know which list you are in and what is filtered. Creating a list was reworked: the form appears right under the list, an empty name shows an inline “Enter a list name” instead of doing nothing (which is what made the 创建 button look unresponsive on Android), the form scrolls itself into view when the keyboard opens, and on phones the language pickers stack with full-width buttons. On the practice screen the review and quiz split is now measured from the content width with a card of at least 560dp, so a wide window no longer squeezes the card into a narrow column. Flashcards follow the reference: two paper edges peek out behind the card, the front keeps only the part-of-speech label and the word, and a round action row under the card holds favorite, speak and skip.
